_comment: Verified SQL queries sourced directly from the Collibra hackathon notebook. Known-correct answers included. SQLite adaptations: remove 'centercode.' prefix, replace ::int with CAST(), replace ::date with DATE(), replace true/false with 1/0.
_sqlite_notes: Remove 'centercode.' schema prefix — tables are loaded flat into SQLite
Replace col::int with CAST(col AS INTEGER)
Z_PRJ_NR in zcc_tkt_itm and zcc_ptm_lnk is the FK to zcc_prj_hdr.Z_PRJ_OID
Z_RTG_VAL in zcc_qa_sat is the satisfaction rating column (not Z_SAT_RTG)
zcc_qa_sat joins to zcc_prj_hdr on Z_PRJ_NR (not Z_PRJ_OID)
Z_SMTP_HSH in zcc_usr_mstr joins to Z_SMTP_ADR in zcc_prt_mtrc

queries.description: How many projects are currently ongoing?
queries.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS ongoing_project_count
FROM zcc_prj_hdr pr
WHERE pr.Z_PRJ_STAT = 'Ongoing'

queries.description: Total number of distinct feedback tickets across all projects
queries.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ft.Z_TKT_NR) AS total_feedback_tickets
FROM zcc_tkt_itm ft

queries.description: What is the latest / most recently created project?
queries.verified_answer: AI writing assistant for asset pages (Ongoing, 2026-02-23)
queries.sql:
SELECT pr.Z_PRJ_TXT, pr.Z_PRJ_STAT, pr.Z_CRT_DAT
FROM zcc_prj_hdr pr
ORDER BY pr.Z_CRT_DAT DESC
LIMIT 1

queries.description: How many unique participants are there across all projects?
queries.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pa.Z_SMTP_ADR) AS unique_participant_count
FROM zcc_prt_mtrc pa

queries.description: Top 10 projects by number of feedback tickets submitted
queries.sql:
SELECT
  pr.Z_PRJ_TXT,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ft.Z_TKT_NR) AS ticket_count
FROM zcc_prj_hdr pr
JOIN zcc_tkt_itm ft ON pr.Z_PRJ_NR = ft.Z_PRJ_NR
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 10

queries.description: How many participants are in the Control Tower program?
queries.notes: A participant is anyone in the project with a project_team. Requires join through zcc_ptm_lnk. Filter on Z_PRJ_TXT = 'Control Tower'.
queries.sql:
SELECT
  pr.Z_PRJ_OID,
  pr.Z_PRJ_TXT,
  COUNT(DISTINCT pa.Z_SMTP_ADR) AS participant_count
FROM zcc_prj_hdr pr
JOIN zcc_prt_mtrc pa ON pr.Z_PRJ_OID = pa.Z_PRJ_OID
JOIN zcc_ptm_lnk pj ON pr.Z_PRJ_OID = pj.Z_PRJ_NR
WHERE pr.Z_PRJ_TXT = 'Control Tower'
GROUP BY pr.Z_PRJ_OID, pr.Z_PRJ_TXT

queries.description: Customer satisfaction rating for a specific named project
queries.verified_answer: 4.5 for Technical Lineage for Google Dataplex via Edge
queries.notes: CRITICAL: satisfaction rating column is Z_RTG_VAL (not Z_SAT_RTG). zcc_qa_sat joins to zcc_prj_hdr on Z_PRJ_NR. Replace project name as needed.
queries.sql:
SELECT
  pr.Z_PRJ_TXT,
  AVG(sa.Z_RTG_VAL * 1.00) AS rating
FROM zcc_prj_hdr pr
JOIN zcc_qa_sat sa ON pr.Z_PRJ_OID = sa.Z_PRJ_NR
WHERE pr.Z_PRJ_TXT = 'Technical Lineage for Google Dataplex via Edge'
GROUP BY pr.Z_PRJ_TXT

queries.description: Average satisfaction rating across all projects or per project
queries.notes: CRITICAL: satisfaction rating column is Z_RTG_VAL (not Z_SAT_RTG). zcc_qa_sat joins on Z_PRJ_NR.
queries.sql:
SELECT
  pr.Z_PRJ_TXT,
  ROUND(AVG(sa.Z_RTG_VAL * 1.00), 2) AS avg_rating
FROM zcc_prj_hdr pr
JOIN zcc_qa_sat sa ON pr.Z_PRJ_OID = sa.Z_PRJ_NR
GROUP BY pr.Z_PRJ_TXT
ORDER BY avg_rating DESC

queries.description: Top 5 ongoing projects with the highest number of issues (excluding Not Applicable status)
queries.verified_answer: 1. Technical lineage viewer (63), 2. Semantic Model Generation (39), 3. Early Adopters Unified Data (37), 4. Template project (33), 5. Derived relations (27)
queries.notes: Filter Z_TKT_ST != 'Not Applicable' AND Z_TKT_ART = 'issue'. A project without a participant is not considered ongoing.
queries.sql:
SELECT
  pr.Z_PRJ_TXT,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ft.Z_TKT_NR) AS issue_total_count
FROM zcc_prj_hdr pr
JOIN zcc_tkt_itm ft ON pr.Z_PRJ_OID = ft.Z_PRJ_NR
WHERE pr.Z_PRJ_STAT = 'Ongoing'
  AND ft.Z_TKT_ST <> 'Not Applicable'
  AND ft.Z_TKT_ART = 'issue'
GROUP BY pr.Z_PRJ_TXT
ORDER BY issue_total_count DESC
LIMIT 5

queries.description: Top 3 feature improvements (ideas) with highest impact score in Collibra AI Copilot project
queries.notes: Feature improvements = tickets with Z_TKT_ART = 'idea'. Status (implemented/open/new) is in Z_TKT_ST.
queries.sql:
SELECT
  ft.Z_SMTP_ADR,
  ft.Z_TKT_NR AS ticket_id,
  ft.Z_TKT_ST,
  ft.Z_IMP_SC AS avg_impact_score
FROM zcc_tkt_itm ft
JOIN zcc_prj_hdr pr ON ft.Z_PRJ_NR = pr.Z_PRJ_OID
WHERE pr.Z_PRJ_TXT = 'Collibra AI Copilot'
  AND ft.Z_TKT_ART = 'idea'
ORDER BY ft.Z_IMP_SC DESC
LIMIT 3

queries.description: Which participant from which company submitted at least 2 feature improvements with the biggest average impact?
queries.notes: Join zcc_tkt_itm to zcc_knt_mstr on Z_KNT_NR for company name (Z_KNT_TXT). Filter Z_TKT_ART = 'idea'. HAVING count >= 2.
queries.sql:
SELECT
  ft.Z_SMTP_ADR,
  kn.Z_KNT_TXT,
  COUNT(ft.Z_TKT_NR) AS ticket_count,
  AVG(ft.Z_IMP_SC) AS avg_impact_score
FROM zcc_tkt_itm ft
JOIN zcc_knt_mstr kn ON ft.Z_KNT_NR = kn.Z_KNT_NR
WHERE ft.Z_TKT_ART = 'idea'
GROUP BY ft.Z_SMTP_ADR, kn.Z_KNT_TXT
HAVING COUNT(ft.Z_TKT_NR) >= 2
ORDER BY avg_impact_score DESC
LIMIT 5

queries.description: How many active testers in the Control Tower project?
queries.notes: Active Tester criteria (AT LEAST ONE): (1) feedback_tickets >= 3, (2) CAST(Z_SRV_CMP AS INTEGER) >= 2, (3) Z_ACT_CMP > Z_ACT_INC + Z_ACT_BLK + Z_ACT_OPT. Join tkt_itm on Z_SMTP_ADR AND Z_PRJ_OID = Z_PRJ_NR.
queries.sql:
WITH feedback_completion AS (
  SELECT
    ft.Z_SMTP_ADR,
    ft.Z_PRJ_NR,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ft.Z_TKT_NR) AS feedback_ticket_count
  FROM zcc_tkt_itm ft
  GROUP BY ft.Z_SMTP_ADR, ft.Z_PRJ_NR
),
participant_status AS (
  SELECT
    pa.Z_SMTP_ADR,
    pa.Z_PRJ_OID,
    pa.Z_PRJ_TXT,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(fc.feedback_ticket_count, 0) >= 3
        OR CAST(COALESCE(pa.Z_SRV_CMP, 0) AS INTEGER) >= 2
        OR COALESCE(pa.Z_ACT_CMP, 0)
           > COALESCE(pa.Z_ACT_INC, 0)
           + COALESCE(pa.Z_ACT_BLK, 0)
           + COALESCE(pa.Z_ACT_OPT, 0)
      THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END AS is_active_tester
  FROM zcc_prt_mtrc pa
  LEFT JOIN feedback_completion fc
    ON pa.Z_SMTP_ADR = fc.Z_SMTP_ADR
    AND pa.Z_PRJ_OID = fc.Z_PRJ_NR
  WHERE pa.Z_PRJ_TXT = 'Control Tower'
)
SELECT
  ps.Z_PRJ_OID,
  ps.Z_PRJ_TXT,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ps.is_active_tester = 1 THEN ps.Z_SMTP_ADR END) AS active_tester_count
FROM participant_status ps
GROUP BY ps.Z_PRJ_OID, ps.Z_PRJ_TXT

queries.description: Active tester count for all projects (no project filter)
queries.notes: Same CTE as control tower version — remove the WHERE clause on Z_PRJ_TXT.
queries.sql:
WITH feedback_completion AS (
  SELECT
    ft.Z_SMTP_ADR,
    ft.Z_PRJ_NR,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ft.Z_TKT_NR) AS feedback_ticket_count
  FROM zcc_tkt_itm ft
  GROUP BY ft.Z_SMTP_ADR, ft.Z_PRJ_NR
),
participant_status AS (
  SELECT
    pa.Z_SMTP_ADR,
    pa.Z_PRJ_OID,
    pa.Z_PRJ_TXT,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(fc.feedback_ticket_count, 0) >= 3
        OR CAST(COALESCE(pa.Z_SRV_CMP, 0) AS INTEGER) >= 2
        OR COALESCE(pa.Z_ACT_CMP, 0)
           > COALESCE(pa.Z_ACT_INC, 0)
           + COALESCE(pa.Z_ACT_BLK, 0)
           + COALESCE(pa.Z_ACT_OPT, 0)
      THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END AS is_active_tester
  FROM zcc_prt_mtrc pa
  LEFT JOIN feedback_completion fc
    ON pa.Z_SMTP_ADR = fc.Z_SMTP_ADR
    AND pa.Z_PRJ_OID = fc.Z_PRJ_NR
)
SELECT
  ps.Z_PRJ_TXT,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ps.is_active_tester = 1 THEN ps.Z_SMTP_ADR END) AS active_tester_count
FROM participant_status ps
GROUP BY ps.Z_PRJ_TXT
ORDER BY active_tester_count DESC

queries.description: Preview projects with Delta Impact Score over 100% but fewer than 20 active testers
queries.verified_answer: 6 projects: Data Quality Rule Filtering, Snowflake 2.0 Lineage Harvester, Collibra AI SQL Assistant, New Data Marketplace experience, dbt Lineage Harvester, Databricks Unity Catalog integration
queries.notes: Delta Impact Score column is Z_HLT_DTA in zcc_prj_hdr. Active tester CTE same as above.
queries.sql:
WITH feedback_completion AS (
  SELECT ft.Z_SMTP_ADR, ft.Z_PRJ_NR,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ft.Z_TKT_NR) AS feedback_ticket_count
  FROM zcc_tkt_itm ft
  GROUP BY ft.Z_SMTP_ADR, ft.Z_PRJ_NR
),
participant_status AS (
  SELECT pa.Z_SMTP_ADR, pa.Z_PRJ_OID,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(fc.feedback_ticket_count, 0) >= 3
        OR CAST(COALESCE(pa.Z_SRV_CMP, 0) AS INTEGER) >= 2
        OR COALESCE(pa.Z_ACT_CMP, 0) > COALESCE(pa.Z_ACT_INC, 0) + COALESCE(pa.Z_ACT_BLK, 0) + COALESCE(pa.Z_ACT_OPT, 0)
      THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END AS is_active_tester
  FROM zcc_prt_mtrc pa
  LEFT JOIN feedback_completion fc ON pa.Z_SMTP_ADR = fc.Z_SMTP_ADR AND pa.Z_PRJ_OID = fc.Z_PRJ_NR
),
active_counts AS (
  SELECT Z_PRJ_OID,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_active_tester = 1 THEN Z_SMTP_ADR END) AS active_tester_count
  FROM participant_status
  GROUP BY Z_PRJ_OID
)
SELECT pr.Z_PRJ_OID, pr.Z_PRJ_TXT, pr.Z_HLT_DTA AS delta_impact_score, ac.active_tester_count
FROM zcc_prj_hdr pr
JOIN active_counts ac ON pr.Z_PRJ_OID = ac.Z_PRJ_OID
WHERE pr.Z_HLT_DTA > 100
  AND ac.active_tester_count < 20
ORDER BY pr.Z_HLT_DTA DESC

queries.description: Most active participant for projects that started in 2025, balanced rank across feedback tickets and activities completed
queries.notes: Activity = feedback tickets + activities. Rank on both metrics independently, sum ranks (lower combined rank = more active). Join zcc_usr_mstr via Z_SMTP_HSH = Z_SMTP_ADR. SQLite: use DATE() instead of ::date cast.
queries.sql:
WITH feedback AS (
  SELECT ft.Z_PRJ_NR, ft.Z_SMTP_ADR,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ft.Z_TKT_NR) AS feedback_tickets
  FROM zcc_tkt_itm ft
  GROUP BY ft.Z_PRJ_NR, ft.Z_SMTP_ADR
),
user_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    us.Z_KNT_NR,
    ac.Z_KNT_TXT,
    us.Z_SMTP_HSH,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.feedback_tickets), 0) AS total_feedback_tickets,
    COALESCE(SUM(pa.Z_ACT_CMP), 0) AS total_activities_completed
  FROM zcc_prt_mtrc pa
  JOIN zcc_prj_hdr pr ON pr.Z_PRJ_OID = pa.Z_PRJ_OID
  JOIN zcc_usr_mstr us ON us.Z_SMTP_HSH = pa.Z_SMTP_ADR
  JOIN zcc_knt_mstr ac ON ac.Z_KNT_NR = us.Z_KNT_NR
  LEFT JOIN feedback f ON pa.Z_PRJ_OID = f.Z_PRJ_NR AND pa.Z_SMTP_ADR = f.Z_SMTP_ADR
  WHERE DATE(pr.Z_CRT_DAT) >= '2025-01-01'
    AND DATE(pr.Z_CRT_DAT) <= '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY us.Z_KNT_NR, ac.Z_KNT_TXT, us.Z_SMTP_HSH
)
SELECT Z_KNT_NR, Z_KNT_TXT, Z_SMTP_HSH,
  total_feedback_tickets, total_activities_completed,
  (total_feedback_tickets + total_activities_completed) AS combined_activity_score
FROM user_metrics
ORDER BY combined_activity_score DESC
LIMIT 10
